reuse.why: Uses the shared isDailyWeekendSkipping, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, recurConfigToRSchedule and RSchedule, the same helpers getUpcomingDates and getNextDate rely on.

duplication.why: The per-occurrence 'daily: drop weekend days, otherwise move if skipWeekend' branch is re-written here as in getUpcomingDates, getNextDate and schedule-template rather than extracted once.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered like it, though the weekend-resolution branch arguably belongs with the helpers in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Adds only the handler, its registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Short and readable, but a future weekend-rule change must also edit this copy of the branch, and its silent `weekendSolveMode ?? 'after'` default differs from the other sites.
